notes: The Bird Three (2021) is Bird's third-generation shared scooter, built around a hermetically sealed, tamper-resistant battery pack of up to 1 kWh — the largest in the shared-scooter industry at launch — with IP68-rated protection. It features dual independent drum brakes, autonomous emergency braking sensors, and a rated chassis lifespan of over 14,000 miles for fleet durability.

failure_modes.name: BMS cell-imbalance lockout
failure_modes.symptoms: Vehicle refuses to unlock, reports low SOC despite recent charge, thermal warnings in fleet dashboard
failure_modes.mitigation: Swap pack at warehouse, run balance-charge cycle, retire packs past cycle-count threshold

failure_modes.name: Drum brake wear/glazing
failure_modes.symptoms: Increased stopping distance, squealing, brake lever travel to bar
failure_modes.mitigation: Scheduled brake inspection every 2-4 weeks in fleet rotation; replace shoes and adjust cable

failure_modes.name: IoT module GPS/LTE dropout
failure_modes.symptoms: Vehicle goes dark on fleet map, cannot be located or remotely locked
failure_modes.mitigation: OTA firmware watchdog reboot; replace IoT board or antenna; sweep last-known-location zones

failure_modes.name: Charge/battery connector corrosion
failure_modes.symptoms: Intermittent charging, error codes, no-power events after rain exposure
failure_modes.mitigation: Dielectric grease on connectors, inspect seals during service, replace corroded harness pigtails

failure_modes.name: Vandalism / cable cut
failure_modes.symptoms: Severed brake or throttle cables, smashed display, bent stem, missing QR codes
failure_modes.mitigation: Anti-tamper fasteners, geofenced no-park zones, rapid retrieval of reported vehicles, full safety inspection before redeploy

failure_modes.name: Tire puncture / flat
failure_modes.symptoms: Pulling to one side, low ride height, vibration
failure_modes.mitigation: Use sealant-filled or solid-core tires, pressure check during battery swaps
